notes.title: Announcing STRIDE: Fates - sequel to STRIDE
notes.notes:
Enhancing everything players love about the freerunning nature of STRIDE, the full-fledged sequel 'Fates' pushes the parkour action formula even further with new gameplay and a story-driven campaign.

The game will be available on Steam next year:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597880/STRIDE_Fates/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597880/STRIDE_Fates/[/url]

[h3]Players who bought STRIDE in Early Access on Steam will get an exclusive offer on Fates, please scroll down for more details.[/h3]

For further updates, follow STRIDE: Fates on social media:
[list]
[*] Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/StrideVR ]https://twitter.com/StrideVR [/url]
[*] YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/JoyWay]https://www.youtube.com/c/JoyWay[/url]
[*] DS: [url=discord.gg/FSbEYSg6bZ]discord.gg/FSbEYSg6bZ[/url]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=BVbfqyxkArU;full]https://youtu.be/BVbfqyxkArU[/previewyoutube]
[h2]Is STRIDE: Fates a separate game?[/h2]

Yes, Fates is a true sequel and a full-fledged separate game by all means, from content and playtime to technology and value for the players.

[h3]This decision has several reasons: [/h3]

[h3]1️⃣ Player value[/h3]

Back in December last year, we planned to release Fates as a new game mode with a free update, with corresponding scope.

But after hearing the voices of our players and the VR community, it was decided to go all-in and make the best game we are capable of. The update was officially canceled in less than a week from its original announcement.

Instead of an hour of gameplay, we made a separate game, better in every aspect, with new content, mechanics and 5-8 hours of story campaign (depending on side quests and time spent in open world locations).

In the latest trailers, we have only shown you a few locations, and haven't even touched on characters, quests and other content yet. More surprises will come that we don't want to spoil right now.

[h3]2️⃣ Technological advancement[/h3]

The development of STRIDE started back in 2019 with a small team of very enthusiastic, but new-to-the-scene developers. With all the years of updates and introduction of multiplayer, the code base of the project has been growing larger and more convoluted. Despite several restructurizations, some technical debt and restrictions are still present in the project.

When we started developing Fates as an update / DLC, we encountered the limitations of the original STRIDE, as the new project contains a lot of content that is very different from the original. The new content required significant changes to the game engine and other technical aspects.

At some point, after fruitless attempts to upgrade the existing engine, we had to restart the project and basically re-do almost all the code from scratch, and now the new engine is incompatible with the original STRIDE.

Reworked STRIDE Engine now offers advanced levels of graphics, physics and interactivity. We refined every aspect of the original STRIDE: shooting and weapons, enemy variety and their AI… the list goes on and on.

When you run, fight, interact with characters or solve puzzles, you will feel a major leap in technology.

[h2]What content will the game feature?[/h2]

STRIDE: Fates is a story-driven adventure, set in a wide range of locations of a dystopian Airon City. From dirty slums to affluent skyscrapers, you will parkour and shoot your way through many places to challenge your reflexes and enjoy the view.

Blockbuster-level narrative.
[list]
[*] Climb buildings, vault through windows, and slide down cables with lightning speed.
[*] Explore open-world locations under the watch of snipers and drones.
[*] Feel the thrill of close-quarters combat with tactical shooter mechanics.
[*] Use your gadgets and hacking skills to outwit thugs and corporates.
[*] Meet a motley cast of characters to shape your Fate. 
[*] Puzzles, collectibles and more cool stuff that will be announced later. 
[/list]
In terms of length, the campaign will take 5-8 hours of action-packed gameplay (depending on side quests and time spent in open world locations). 

[h2]Story Setup[/h2]

Step into the shoes of Nick Young - a parkour spec-ops officer (aka chaser). Raised in the slums of Airon City, at the very bottom of the food chain, he got a golden ticket out.

To survive and climb the ladder in elite police forces of SkyChase, you will have to deal with power shifts in gangs, dirty family feuds, corporate secrets, forbidden tech and much more.

Your fate is bound with other motley characters in this story. Will you accept the destiny or fight against it? 

[h2]How much will the game cost?[/h2]

We will announce the price a little later. It will be a full price for a VR game, adequate to the market. 

It's important to remember that on Steam, while the game was in Early Access, it was stated on the store page that a story mode will be available for free one day. We fully appreciate our early adopters. Despite the fact that the game grew in gameplay value and received numerous updates that weren't initially planned (including multiplayer, currently counting 6 game modes), we know that many of you have been waiting for the campaign. 

And therefore, Steam players who bought the game in Early Access (between Sept 4, 2020 and June 10, 2022) can get Fates for free at launch. Because, at that time, story content was listed on the store page. In order to do that, please write us an email to stride.fates@joyway.games with your Steam account username and a screenshot of purchase history.

[h2]Add Fates to your wish list and stay tuned, we have a lot of closed tests planned! 

Sign up here:  [url=https://stride-fates.joyway.games/beta]https://stride-fates.joyway.games/beta[/url][/h2]

notes.title: TAG CHAMPIONS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Long live tournaments in Stride! Welcome a new update with:

New **Tag Champions (TC)** multiplayer mode, in which players from different teams take on the roles of chasers and evaders, earning points for their teams.

Rules:

- Two teams of 1-3 players compete in a series of 30-second 1v1 chases on the rooftop of a skyscraper.
- Each player starts as a chaser or an evader. When the chaser tags the evader, the roles switch. 
- The chase winner becomes an evader but no more than twice in a row.
- The time the evader lasted goes towards their team's score.
- A player who falls off the skyscraper loses.

Note❗️ Read more detailed rules in the next posts.

New map for the TC mode:

- An arena where players compete as evaders and chasers.
- A cozy waiting area where players from different teams watch the match and score, waiting for their turn.

New effects added for bHaptics devices for better immersion:

- Haptics effects when you're tagging a player or are getting tagged.

And last but not least!

Bug fixes:

- Fixed some initialization errors when entering multiplayer.
- Fixed problems with hand tracking.
- Fixed problems with server responsiveness when tagging/hitting a player in melee.
- Fixed a bug with player models being only partially visible.
- Some bugs with daily quests have also been fixed.

It's time to challenge your skills and stamina! 

Check the second post to learn more about the upcoming tournament with major prizes 🔥

Joy Way ❤️

notes.title: STRIDE - Multiplayer Fixes & Improvements
STRIDE - Run & Gun Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Striders!

Multiplayer just received a major update. 3 new game modes with guns, 4 maps, a player progression system with 50 new cosmetic items, and more!

[previewyoutube=iZOdnY4FOEg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Combat Game Modes[/h2]

[b]Deathmatch[/b] - the classic "all against all", up to 10 players in a match. The player's objective is to do more kills than their opponent(s) for that game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/5be9baa39602a2c1b09f0d240cfc915373b4f24c.png[/img]

[b]Team Deathmatch[/b] - all players are split into 2 teams, up to 5x5 players. Cover your teammates and hold key locations on the map with useful pick-ups to seize the advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/d874ea298fcebc9eca49c85fc8dd0774f7a43907.png[/img]

[b]Capture the Flag[/b] - steal the enemy’s flag and deliver it to your base as quickly as possible. Try to follow the most optimal path and avoid confrontation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/dba8fbacf70942352c2517e479f1b8d19b6579c2.png[/img]

[h2]New Maps for the Combat Modes[/h2]

[b]Rooftops [/b] is a large map with a lot of room for parkour stunts. A distinctive feature of this map is the contrasting environment. Players can move along the upper, more open tiers of buildings, and can traverse narrow streets, hidden under the canopy of concrete jungles. Gunfights also take place indoors, in two buildings with different structures and interiors. The first is a tall building with several floors. The second is a one-story building that allows relatively safe passage to different parts of the map.

[b]Cityscrapers[/b] is a linear map where the main clash takes place on the frame of an abandoned skyscraper. Moving along the steel beams of the frame is dangerous, but it allows skilled players to get powerful pick-ups and quickly reach the enemy base. On the contrary, there are also longer, but safer paths that bypass the skyscraper through the roofs of neighboring buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/ce7d3e49639ed9139086bfd851bd1d74f921a79a.png[/img]

[b]Neon[/b]: the competition leaves the roofs and construction sites for a completely enclosed space. The map is a two-story nightclub consisting of an open space with a stage in the middle, and a complicated network of narrow rooms and balconies. New players can easily move around the first floor, and more skilled ones are able to move along the beams and balconies of the second floor.

[b]Penthouse[/b]: visually and gameplay-wise, the map can be divided into two parts. The first is the roof of a large penthouse. Shootings happen there in open areas near swimming pools. And risky players can run along the balconies and the edge of the roof to collect powerful pick-ups. The second part of the map is a skyscraper under construction and the roofs of small penthouses adjacent to it. In this half of the map there are more opportunities for parkour and shooting inside relatively small and enclosed spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/4e4fc994f3dea0fe356046ddc9c6c2fdb0067662.png[/img]

[h2]NEW WEAPONRY[/h2]

[b]Pick-Ups[/b]
• Health Packs - restore 25/50 HP.
• Armor - gain 100 extra HP.
• Ammo - pick up to replenish ammunition.

[b]Weapons[/b]
• Knife - standard melee weapon.
• Pistol - standard ranged weapon, a STRIDE’s classic.
• Shotgun  - pickable weapon with high damage but low rate of fire.
• UZI  - pickable weapon with high rate of fire but moderate damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/858f3028c2ac92c16d4538a65f106109be33beae.png[/img]

[b]Aiming practice[/b]
We have added a new shooting gallery area in the lobby for aiming practice.

[h2]New Social Features[/h2]

• [b]Personal Bubble[/b] - feature for social distancing in the Lobby. This bubble creates a safe space for the user that cannot be breached by other players. When turned on, other players will disappear if they get too close to the user.
• [b]Mute All[/b] - mute all other players in one click.
• [b]Ghost All[/b] - mute all players and hide their actions in the Lobby.
• [b]Graffiti Spray[/b] - new type of cosmetic item. Users can apply a range of sprays on any map surface in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/119c54570e5d0c7494dd868999cf556dd69c6f5e.png[/img]

[h2]New Customization and Player Progression[/h2]

We have added a progression system consisting of 50 levels (aka a free Battle Pass). For reaching them, the player will receive 50 new cosmetic items:
• Graffiti - sprays (6 items).
• Taunt screen - post-mortem animation (5 items).
• Face Display - animation on the player’s virtual HMD playing when he/she taps around the temples (6 items).
• Watches - custom interactive watches (4 items).
• Wardrobe - themed skins for the player’s avatar (+3 items).
• Banners - banners with the player’s nickname above their head (6 items).
• Guns - skins for the pistol, UZI, shotgun, and knife (5 items each).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/cc5875fa7c24c34a02031b7d339a255e23ec6734.png[/img]

[h2]Other Impovements[/h2]

• Improved scoreboards in Horde and KOTH.
• Added extra rounds in Horde if a match ends too quickly.
• Improved servers.
• Bug fixes and other enhancements.

Have fun and let us know what you think! Feel free to share your feedback and found bugs in our [url=https://discord.gg/QBr4WDkqWQ]Discord community[/url].

Cheers,
Joy Way

notes.title: STRIDE - Arena Update
notes.notes:
Hey striders! 

A new content update is here, bringing major changes and improvements to the single-player Arena Mode, as well as other enhancements.

[previewyoutube=ux0nbhbJUKo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ARENA MODE REWORK[/h2]

Arena runs are now capped at 20 minutes. After this time, the run ends even if the player is still alive, and the final score is displayed. 

As you progress, the quests and the Arena itself evolve, increasing the difficulty.

[h3]Quest Changes [/h3]
1. Eliminate Enemies - improved.
• Time to complete this quest decreases with each completed quest (to a certain minimum limit). 
• The number of enemies to kill increases every 2nd quest (up to 5 enemies in total). After the 6th quest, new enemies start using grenades.
• The rate of fire of enemies also increases with each completed quest. 

2. Kill Drones - improved.
• Time to complete this quest decreases with each completed quest (to a certain minimum limit). 
• The number of drones to kill increases every 2nd quest (up to 5 drones in total). After the 6th quest, drones start spawning air mines.  After the 10th quest, drones get weapons and engage the player within a certain range.
• The flight speed and manoeuvrability of drones also increase with each completed quest. 

3. Hack the Data - improved.
• Time to complete this quest decreases with each completed quest (to a certain minimum limit). 
• The flight speed of the drone increases with each completed task, as well as the time it takes to hack it.

4. Reach Zones - removed from the game.
5. Collect Cases - removed from the game.
6. Hook the Drone - removed from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/99b26afb70ff4f3512f66a3da31ff1bac51f0c8a.png[/img]

[h3]More Verticality and New Interiors[/h3]
Explore a bunch of new rooms and buildings on the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/5a47813bfe24f8dfd949562e897cca8634e7cc7c.png[/img]

[h3]Neutral Drones[/h3]
Drones, originally introduced in the Hook the Drone quest, now fly around the map rather chaotically, creating dynamic grappling points for the player.

[h3]Money and Upgrades[/h3]
Suitcases (previously used for the Collect Cases quest) now spawn randomly on the map. For collecting them, the player gets money that can be exchanged for temporary upgrades or consumables (new weapons, the laser sight, health packs, etc.). To buy upgrades, find a vending machine. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/bf73e14359b2593c4cc81a193536335a279d1380.png[/img]

[h3]Increasing Difficulty[/h3]
Just like the new quests, the Arena itself becomes more and more difficult as the player progresses. 
The number of enemies and traps increases over time, while the number of neutral drones goes down. To balance this, the number and quality of available updates gradually increases.

[h2]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
• Arena leaderboards have been reset.
• Time Run levels now unlock progressively. Complete the first level to unlock the next one, and so on. 
• The tutorial has been updated.
• New models for enemies.
• Bug fixes and other enhancements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/3bb3fec603f92d7d5cc9e5e06a8578f3456d6a2a.png[/img]

Have fun and let us know what you think! 

Feel free to share your feedback and found bugs in our [url=https://discord.gg/QBr4WDkqWQ]Discord community[/url].

Cheers,
Joy Way

STRIDE - Guns N’ Drones Update

Hey striders!

A new content update is already here, and it’s aimed at diversifying your single-player experience! Let’s see what we have.

It will be available from the main client, so you won't need a separate app to play the multiplayer. 

We see STRIDE Multiplayer as a competitive game with a high skill ceiling, but at the same time with a room for more casual players who will find activities to their liking. Easy to learn, hard to master.

Survivors must avoid being touched by infected zombie players, while zombies must infect as many survivors as possible within the allotted time.

The main gameplay focus is on action packed parkour chases and escapes. The players must utilize their VR parkour skills to jump from ledges, dive under obstacles, and slide down cables to avoid infection or take down the remaining survivors.

At launch, the multiplayer will feature:
• 2 game modes;
• 4 maps;
• Player hub with mini-games and training grounds;
• Matchmaking system; 
• Social features like a voice chat, player avatar customization, etc.

.. and we are already working on future updates that will bring new modes, maps, social features like private lobbies, and other cool stuff that we don't want to spoil yet.

Along with the multiplayer, the full release will bring [b]a major content update to the existing offline game modes[/b]. We will share more details closer to the release date, but for now we can say with confidence that hardcore and casual players, as well as fans of VR fitness, will definitely like it.

After the full release, STRIDE should be treated as a complete title. Nonetheless, we will continue to regularly update the game, and anticipating your next question, we do continue to work on single-player content with story elements, though our main focus for the near future will be on the multiplayer. notes.title: Update 9.0 is finally here!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited global 9.0 update is here, bringing STRIDE to the next level of gameplay diversity, replayablility and immersiveness. Hooray!

As you know, the transition to Unreal Engine v4.27 was painful, it completely broke the game code. To date, we managed to fix everything, except for some minor lightning and contrast issues in Endless and Time Run. They are not critical, so we decided to release the update on schedule, to meet the promised deadline. If you want to compare the new update with the previous one, the previous build of the game is still accessible via the beta branch on Steam. Thank you for your patience and support :)

We know that along with the update, many players have been waiting for news about the story mode and multiplayer. STRIDE recently turned its first year, and it's time to take stock and look into the future of the game.

[previewyoutube=A3_jPH2Ah8k;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]UPDATE 9.0 CHANGELOG[/b]

[b]General changes[/b]
• Redesigned game modes
• Redesigned score systems in all game modes. The leaderboards have been reset. 
• Reworked graphics, to bring the game to a uniform visual style on all platforms
• Completely reworked tutorial, now it's more VR newbie-friendly

[b]Enemies[/b]
• Melee combat
• Improved enemy AI
• Voiceovers for enemies. They shout different phrases depending on the player's actions
• New enemy type for the Endless Mode: a battle drone. It drops 3 types of mines to stop the player
• Now enemies in the Arena Mode can throw grenades at the player. The player can catch grenades and throw them back

[b]Endless Mode[/b]
• New sections for the generation pool
• 2 new difficulty levels: Harmless and Expert
• 3 new types of power-ups that may be found at the scenes of battles in both Endless and Arena game modes.

[b]Arena Mode[/b]
• New sections for the generation pool
• New modifiers that allow you to freerun, practicing and enjoying the view
• New in-door locations for the Arena Mode with different interiors
• 3 new types of power-ups

[b]Time Run[/b]
• There are no more enemies in Time Run, now it's a pure parkour mode
• New time trials

[b]Immersiveness and realism[/b]
• Improved gunplay
• Now the gun has a flash when fired
• New interactive elements: openable doors and breakable windows
• Improved, more immersive player hands

[b]Player progression[/b]
• Achievement system
• Skins for the gun, gloves and the hookshot. Skins can be obtained by completing certain achievements and participating in future events

[b]Along with a huge list of bug fixes, improvements and new settings. Go check everything yourself! [/b]

If you or your friends haven't played STRIDE before - this is the best moment to start. We have reduced the price on Steam to make it the same on al platforms. On top of that, a special Halloween sale discount is valid until November 1.

Let's discuss the update and the future of STRIDE. Feel free to share your thoughts 💬

And join our [url=https://discord.gg/SekGnWd]Discord community[/url] to stay posted about future updates and beta tests. 

Best,

notes.title: Information about the upcoming major update of STRIDE
notes.notes:
Only for 4 days, from now until September 13, STRIDE will be be on sale with a [b]biggest-ever discount - 30% [/b]

This discount was supposed to be timed to coincide with the release of the long-awaited Update 9.0, which should have provided parity with the Quest version of the game in terms of content. 

This means that STRIDE will feature:
• completely reworked tutorial, now it's more VR newbie-friendly 
• reworked graphics
• improved enemy AI
• improved gunplay 
• new interactive elements: openable doors and breakable windows
• melee combat
• achievement system
• skins for the gun, gloves and the hookshot. Skins can be obtained by completing certain achievements and participating in future events.
• improved, more immersive player hands
• 2 new difficulty levels for the Endless Mode: Harmless and Expert
• new sections for the Endless Mode generation pool.
• new enemy type for the Endless Mode: a battle drone. It drops 3 types of mines to stop the player.
• 3 new types of power-ups that may be found at the scenes of battles in both Endless and Arena game modes.

Not to mention a looong list of bug fixes, new settings and gameplay improvements.

This update should have been released yesterday. The build of the game was ready, well tested and polished. 

Then we moved to Unreal Engine v4.27, which completely broke the game. Some parts of the code no longer work with SteamVR, and there are now critical bugs that make the game unplayable. 

We moved to Unreal Engine v4.27 since we're developing STRIDE for many platforms simultaniously (including PSVR with a new SDK that reqiuires UE v4.27). Due to some mistakes, we can't rollback the game to the previous version.

Our team was trying to fix the issues until 5 o'clock in the morning to release the update as scheduled, but the problem appears to be bigger than we expected. To be honest, we don't know yet how long it may take to fix all the problems caused by the update - days or weeks. This is really frustrating for the team and the players who have been waiting for the update. 

Such accidents can neither be foreseen nor prevented, but we will deliver what we promised, no matter what. The 9.0 update will be released as quickly as humanly possible. We will keep you posted on the progress.

We're just as mad as you are, and hope that we can get through this together. And we promise that it will worth it - the 9.0 update improves every aspect of the game, bringing STRIDE to the next level of gameplay, replayablility and immersiveness.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567632/000bf6f48608ab114815f573d2a55ae28e7324c1.png[/img]


Season’s greetings from Joy Way!

As we approach the end of the year, we’d like to take the opportunity to thank everyone who helped us make 2020 an incredible journey for Joy Way. We’d also like to highlight a few things we’re excited about for 2021!

We started the year by, well, becoming Joy Way. Our rebrand marked a new chapter in our evolution as a company. In line with wider trends in VR world, we made the decision to focus on developing games for home use only. As in-home VR uptake is growing fast along with the availability and capacity of the technology, we’re sure we made the right choice.  

We released five prototypes in 2020, and two of them turned into full-fledged games!

The biggest success for us this year was undoubtedly Stride. Starting with our early prototypes for the game, the reaction from the community was obvious. We clearly had a hit. 

In 2020, Stride made it as far as Early Access on Steam, but that’s just the beginning. In terms of platforms, we are actively working to ensure that users of Oculus Quest and PSVR can play Stride too. Although the exact date is not entirely in our control, we are confident that the first months of 2021 will see the release of Stride PSVR. As for Oculus Quest, we have a few more hoops to go through, but we are working on it. We hope we’ll have some good news on that front in the very near future. 

As for further development of Stride, we are now actively working on the storyline campaign for the game. We are well aware of your high expectations, and we see it as our sworn duty to meet them. We really want to make this game something special! 

Looking ahead to 2021, we are super excited about two new prototypes we’re working on. First is a game in the rogue-lite genre. Based on early feedback from our initial prototype, we think we may be onto something with this game, so we’ve decided to bring it to life. Expect further developments soon! The second is a rhythm game. We’re working on a prototype for this now too, and we expect to have it ready for you to test in early January. Special thanks to everyone who has pitched in feedback on these games so far!

Our team grew a lot in 2020. But our community of supporters has grown much more! We want to say a huge thank you to each and every one of you. It’s fantastic to have supporters who love VR as much as we do. Earning your positive feedback is a big part of what drives us to work hard every day. 

Many thanks as well to all journalists and bloggers who supported us this year, and of course, to everyone who played our games. Together we are making a positive contribution to the future of VR.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/SekGnWd]Stay tuned [/url] for more news from Joy Way and get ready for another great year!

Joy Way Team ❤️

Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard, finding the most effective path. In this mode, the player will be able to cheerfully shoot at bots, engage in melee (such as pushes and stuns) with bots, and, of course, dodge attacks using parkour skills and stealthy approaches. We will use bot mechanics developed and perfected with this mode for a large campaign down the line.

In the highlighted slice of gameplay, you’ll notice bots are more successful at detecting the player by hearing the noise of movement and shots. They are also now more skilled at shooting.

We are currently working on improvements in animations relating to hitting players, movement, and more interesting and varied variations of the character's death. We experimented with the X-Sense suit to record fall animations. It turned out that recording fall animations is quite problematic, since when a body collides with a hard surface, the sensors get confused and the animation looks dirty. Thanks to this observation, we are now working on a more advanced blend of physics and animation.

We want to teach bots to detect shelters and establish communication with each other so that they understand where the player is and can strategize their response.

The video shows a small cut of the gameplay as it looks now.

Thank you,
Joy Way Team
